metadata.title: Santa Cruz County property taxes
metadata.source_category: Third-party property website; official county residential address inventory
metadata.caveat: Tax sources are labeled per record. County amounts billed and recorded paid are separate; third-party tax-history amounts do not establish payment. Estimates and tax years differ. Assessment years may be unavailable. This is a nonrandom observational sample, not a causal estimate of Proposition 13 or a calculation of tax owed.
